Population increased in West Yorkshire (county)

The estimated population of West Yorkshire (county) in 2024 was 2,435,236 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of West Yorkshire (county) increased by 3.6%.

Age profile of West Yorkshire (county)

The average (median) age stayed at 38.2 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of West Yorkshire (county) has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
By age category, West Yorkshire (county)'s population of 2,435,236 usual residents was made up of:

  • 479,641 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.7%)
  • 1,543,766 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.4%)
  • 411,829 people aged 65 years and over, (16.9%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, West Yorkshire (county) has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 65 years and over (16.9% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In West Yorkshire (county), the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in West Yorkshire (county)
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for West Yorkshire (county), between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 3,852 people (0.2%). In total, there were 25,557 births and 21,705 deaths in West Yorkshire (county).
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 9,167 (-0.4%). There were 77,030 people entering the area and 86,197 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in West Yorkshire (county)'s population of 31,901 (1.3%) as a result of 49,568 people entering the area and 17,667 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for West Yorkshire (county) was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of West Yorkshire (county) in mid-2023 is 2,408,679.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 8,265 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,747 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 6,518 people.
